title: "REFMAP listening test 1 analysis: Inter-rater reliability"
output: html_document
date: "2024-10-04"
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

# Setup

Load packages

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(irr)

```

## Import data and wrangle

### Part A

```{r}

annoyDataApath <- utils::choose.files(caption=r"(Select refmap_listest1_AnnoyDataABySubjWide.csv from 03 Experiment\Experiment 1\Analysis\PostProcess)",
                                     filters=matrix(data=c("refmap_listest1_AnnoyDataABySubjWide.csv",
                                                           "refmap_listest1_AnnoyDataABySubjWide.csv"), ncol=2))

annoyDataA <- read.csv(annoyDataApath, header=TRUE)

# transpose the data
annoyDataA <- setNames(data.frame(t(annoyDataA[,-1])), annoyDataA[,1])
# get rid of the unwanted data rows
annoyDataA <- annoyDataA[1:80,]
# convert to numeric
annoyDataA <- dplyr::mutate_all(annoyDataA, function(x) as.numeric(as.character(x)))

noticeDatapath <- utils::choose.files(caption=r"(Select refmap_listest1_NoticeFiltDataABySubjWide.csv from 03 Experiment\Experiment 1\Analysis\PostProcess)",
                                     filters=matrix(data=c("refmap_listest1_NoticeFiltDataABySubjWide.csv",
                                                           "refmap_listest1_NoticeFiltDataABySubjWide.csv"), ncol=2))

noticeData <- read.csv(noticeDatapath, header=TRUE)

# transpose the data
noticeData <- setNames(data.frame(t(noticeData[,-1])), noticeData[,1])
# get rid of the unwanted data rows
noticeData <- noticeData[1:80,]

# unfiltered notice data, for comparison
noticeUnfiltDatapath <- utils::choose.files(caption=r"(Select refmap_listest1_NoticeDataABySubjWide.csv from 03 Experiment\Experiment 1\Analysis\PostProcess)",
                                     filters=matrix(data=c("refmap_listest1_NoticeDataABySubjWide.csv",
                                                           "refmap_listest1_NoticeDataABySubjWide.csv"), ncol=2))

noticeUnfiltData <- read.csv(noticeUnfiltDatapath, header=TRUE)

# transpose the data
noticeUnfiltData <- setNames(data.frame(t(noticeUnfiltData[,-1])), noticeUnfiltData[,1])
# get rid of the unwanted data rows
noticeUnfiltData <- noticeUnfiltData[1:80,]

```


### Part B

```{r}

annoyDataBpath <- utils::choose.files(caption=r"(Select refmap_listest1_AnnoyDataBBySubjWide.csv from 03 Experiment\Experiment 1\Analysis\PostProcess)",
                                     filters=matrix(data=c("refmap_listest1_AnnoyDataBBySubjWide.csv", "refmap_listest1_AnnoyDataBBySubjWide.csv"), ncol=2))

annoyDataB <- read.csv(annoyDataBpath, header=TRUE)

# transpose the data
annoyDataB <- setNames(data.frame(t(annoyDataB[,-1])), annoyDataB[,1])
# get rid of the unwanted rows
annoyDataB <- annoyDataB[1:17,]
# convert to numeric
annoyDataB <- dplyr::mutate_all(annoyDataB, function(x) as.numeric(as.character(x)))


```

## Calculate ICC

### Part A

```{r}

irr::icc(annoyDataA, model = 'twoway', 
         type = 'consistency', unit = 'average')

irr::icc(annoyDataA, model = 'twoway', 
         type = 'agreement', unit = 'average')

irr::kappam.fleiss(noticeData, exact = TRUE, detail = TRUE)

irr::kappam.fleiss(noticeUnfiltData, exact = TRUE, detail = TRUE)



```


### Part B

```{r}


irr::icc(annoyDataB, model = 'twoway', 
         type = 'consistency', unit = 'average')


irr::icc(annoyDataB, model = 'twoway', 
         type = 'agreement', unit = 'average')


```

### Combined parts A and B, omitting the extra participant in Part B

```{r}

# row bind the two data frames, omitting the extra participant in Part B by 
# identifying which column in B does not appear in A
annoyDataAB <- rbind(annoyDataA, annoyDataB[ , colnames(annoyDataB) %in% colnames(annoyDataA)])


irr::icc(annoyDataAB, model = 'twoway', 
         type = 'consistency', unit = 'average')


irr::icc(annoyDataAB, model = 'twoway', 
         type = 'agreement', unit = 'average')


```
